chunks: As for what al-Husayn ibn Sa'id narrated from al-Hasan, from Zur'ah, from Sama'ah, who said:

I asked him, peace be upon him, about a man who sees semen on his garment after morning has come, and he had not seen in his sleep that he had experienced a wet dream. He said: "Then let him perform ghusl, wash his garment, and repeat his salat." And he narrated this hadith with another wording.

key_terms.احْتَلَمَ: experienced a wet dream in sleep
key_terms.الْمَنِيَّ: semen found on the garment, indicating janabah
key_terms.فَلْيَغْتَسِلْ: let him perform ghusl due to janabah
key_terms.وَلْيَغْسِلْ ثَوْبَهُ: let him wash his garment to remove impurity
key_terms.وَيُعِيدُ صَلَاتَهُ: let him repeat his salat because of the discovered impurity and state

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he finds semen on his clothes in the morning without remembering a wet dream?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who finds semen on his garment in the morning without having noticed a wet dream in sleep. The Imam عليه السلام instructs him to perform ghusl, wash the garment, and repeat the salat, indicating the jurisprudential implications of janabah and ritual impurity.
